t: 2032 — First long-duration isolation protocols testbed runs a sealed pl
title: 2032 — First long-duration isolation protocols testbed runs a sealed pl
definition: 2032 milestone on the Rogue Planet Bases roadmap.
description:
First long-duration isolation protocols testbed runs a sealed planet hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the subsurface habitats recycling math.

What must be true first: the subsurface habitats results have to replicate outside the lab, base logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and geothermal power operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed subsurface habitats demonstrations, base logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting geothermal power uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Rogue Planet Bases
definition: Estimates Rogue Planet Bases readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Rogue Planet Bases components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a planet hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Rogue Planet Bases Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Rogue Planet Bases operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Rogue Planet Bases installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 62236 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where subsurface habitats monitoring, base logistics redundancy, or geothermal power maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Rogue Planet Bases Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Rogue Planet Bases: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Rogue Planet Bases — bases on starless worlds drifting between suns.

Phase 1 — Prove (subsurface habitats): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (base logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (geothermal power): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (isolation protocols): planet hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and interstellar void-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
